DehakaDarkSwarmTalentEnduringSwarm.name: Enduring Swarm
DehakaDarkSwarmTalentEnduringSwarm.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

DehakaEssenceCollectionTalentTissueRegen.name: Tissue Regeneration
DehakaEssenceCollectionTalentTissueRegen.description: Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence. Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

DehakaEssenceCollectionTalentEnhancedAgi.name: Enhanced Agility
DehakaEssenceCollectionTalentEnhancedAgi.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 5 seconds after leaving a bush. Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

DehakaBurrowTalentLurkerStrain.name: Lurker Strain
DehakaBurrowTalentLurkerStrain.description: Emerging from Burrow grants Dehaka Stealth for 3 seconds and knocks nearby enemies back, dealing 125 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Burrow by 3 seconds.

DehakaEssenceCollectionOneWhoCollectsTal.name: One-Who-Collects
DehakaEssenceCollectionOneWhoCollectsTal.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

DehakaEssenceCollectionTalentHeroStalker.name: Hero Stalker
DehakaEssenceCollectionTalentHeroStalker.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence each time an enemy Hero is hit by Dark Swarm.

DehakaDragTalentFeedingFrenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy
DehakaDragTalentFeedingFrenzy.description: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds. Passive: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.

DehakaDragTalentParalyzingEnzymes.name: Paralyzing Enzymes
DehakaDragTalentParalyzingEnzymes.description: Drag Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds after it ends. Gambit: When Drag ends, deal an additional 280 (+4% per level) damage to the target over 2 seconds. Every death reduces this damage by 40 (+4% per level), up to 5 times.

DehakaDarkSwarmTalentSymbiosis.name: Symbiosis
DehakaDarkSwarmTalentSymbiosis.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

DehakaHeroicAbilityIsolation.name: Isolation
DehakaHeroicAbilityIsolation.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

DehakaHeroicAbilityAdaptation.name: Adaptation
DehakaHeroicAbilityAdaptation.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

DehakaBrushstalkerFerociousStalker.name: Ferocious Stalker
DehakaBrushstalkerFerociousStalker.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 60% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

DehakaPrimalSwarm.name: Primal Swarm
DehakaPrimalSwarm.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

DehakaPrimalRage.name: Primal Rage
DehakaPrimalRage.description: Gain 1.25% increased Attack Damage per Essence stored.

DehakaTunnelingClaws.name: Tunneling Claws
DehakaTunnelingClaws.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 125%.

DehakaPackLeaderBrushstalkerTalent.name: Pack Leader
DehakaPackLeaderBrushstalkerTalent.description: Dehaka gains 20 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 5 seconds after leaving.

DehakaIsolationTalentContagion.name: Contagion
DehakaIsolationTalentContagion.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target.

DehakaAdaptationChangeIsSurvivalTalent.name: Change Is Survival
DehakaAdaptationChangeIsSurvivalTalent.description: Increases Adaptation healing to 200% of the damage received and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

DehakaEssenceClaws.name: Essence Claws
DehakaEssenceClaws.description: Dehaka's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1 second. If the target is a Hero, Dehaka gains 5 Essence.

DehakaBrushstalkerApexPredator.name: Apex Predator
DehakaBrushstalkerApexPredator.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by 50 seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.
